artworks.title: Brooklyn Bridge
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside with a view of a sailing ship docked next to a wharf on the left side. Smaller boats with visible masts are seen moving in the water on the right. In the distance, there is a long suspension bridge spanning the horizon. The cityscape lies beneath the bridge. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like style with fine brushstrokes, creating a textured and intricate depiction. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones and soft earth hues.

artworks.title: Florence Leyland
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a girl in a full-length view. She is standing, facing slightly to her right, with one foot stepping forward. Her facial features are delicate and youthful, with softly outlined eyes and a serene expression. Her hair is long and wavy, falling past her shoulders with short bangs across her forehead. She is dressed in a simple, flowing ankle-length dress and is barefoot. The etching showcases fine details in the fabric of the dress and hair. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of sketch-like vertical lines, and the etching is signed by the artist near the right side of the dress.

artworks.title: Flaming Forge
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a barn scene with animals and farming implements. The drawing showcases a rustic barn with an open, arched doorway revealing an interior with a source of light. In the foreground, there is a pair of animals that are harnessed and a third animal resembling a dog is at the entrance of the barn. The overall composition captures a moment in rural life, with emphasis on the textures and shading to denote various elements such as wooden boards, animals, and hay. The surroundings suggest a setting involved in agricultural or domestic work.

artworks.title: Le Berger et La Bergre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This image depicts a wooded landscape with trees dominating the scene. The perspective is slightly elevated. The brushstrokes show detailed textures of leaves, branches, and sheep's wool. Several sheep are grazing and resting, along with two figures partially concealed by trees. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly using shades of brown to create contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Stags at the Waterside
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed etching of a serene natural scene. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing a calm body of water with reflections, tall trees, and a sky with subtle clouds. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of grey and black to create depth. Cross-hatching techniques are used for texture and dimension.

artworks.title: Ships at the Dock
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)
artworks.description: The image displays a harbor scene with moored ships. A boat named "Blue Jay" is close to the viewer, its bow angled slightly to the left. Other ships are visible along the dock, with various masts reaching into the sky. In the background are dome-topped buildings and a tall smokestack, creating a skyline silhouette. The watercolor brushwork is loose and fluid, depicting motion and reflection. The color scheme is soft, featuring blues, browns, earth tones, and hints of green.

artworks.title: I Went Down that There Slide Faster than the Empire State Express
artworks.medium: conté crayon with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. William J. Glackens, wife of the artist, 1943)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a public scene featuring a carnival or festival setting with exaggerated action. The drawing depicts a large crowd of people gathered, with various individuals wearing hats typical of the early 20th century. The focal point of the scene is a figure sliding down a steep incline or ride, arms flailing, clutching an umbrella and a hat. The background shows a decorative structure resembling a carnival booth or gazebo, with banners and flags. The style of drawing is characterized by expressive line work and energetic strokes that convey motion and excitement within the scene.

artworks.title: Le garde national Rifolard ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures from the knees to the head. The central figure, a man, is kissing a woman on his right. The man has exaggerated facial features and is wearing a formal uniform with a helmet. The woman is leaning forward to receive the kiss, wearing a long, striped dress. The man is holding a child in his left arm, facing away from the viewer. The child has short hair and is reaching towards the man. The man is also holding a rifle, visible behind him. The background features an indoor setting with walls and a lightly sketched frame.

artworks.title: Les débats ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures manipulating a large inflated figure resembling a Cossack. The drawing is a political cartoon depicting a caricatured Cossack figure in flight, tethered to the ground by the two other figures manipulating the strings. The large figure has a sword in each hand, a fur hat, and an exaggerated expression with wide eyes and a gaping mouth. The two figures on the ground are labeled as "L'ASSEMBLÉE NATIONALE" and "L'UNION." They appear to be conspiring together. The scene is set against a faintly sketched cityscape with buildings lacking detail. There is text at the bottom providing a caption in French, suggesting a satirical commentary on political affairs. The drawing style is reminiscent of traditional 19th-century French satirical illustrations.

artworks.title: Tiens, mon ami, voici M. Chapoulard ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image displays a three-quarter view of three individuals interacting. The man on the left has a prominent nose, thin lips, expressive eyes, short gray hair, and a tall top hat. He extends his hand forward. He wears a dark suit with a waistcoat and a white shirt. The man in the middle has a strong jawline, a mustache, and wears a wide-brimmed top hat. He is dressed in a dark suit with an upturned collar. The woman on the right wears a bonnet tied beneath her chin and a long-sleeved dress with a high collar. She has defined features. The background shows faint sketches of buildings with window outlines. The illustration has a textured, sketched appearance with prominent lines and shades.

artworks.title: T'nez not' maitr' en voila un p'tit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two caricatured figures in an outdoor setting. The foreground shows two figures: one wearing a top hat, glasses, and holding a walking stick or a rifle, and the other gesturing broadly. The background includes a rural landscape with bushes, a tree, and a partially visible house. The scene is framed with a title and dialogue in French beneath it, called "Croquis de Chasse" (Hunting Sketch).

artworks.title: Ce ne sont plus des femmes, ce sont des ballons
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows figures with exaggerated clothing in a forest setting. The individuals wear voluminous dresses and are surrounded by trees. The ground beneath them is visible, creating a natural setting. Other simplistic figures wearing top hats are seen in the background. The drawing includes heavy lines and shading to give depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Aspect des boulevards pendant la foire aux bibelots
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image portrays a crowd scene with individuals shown from the waist up. The group is tightly positioned, suggesting a busy environment. Most individuals are men, with at least one woman visible in the center. The men wear dark, high-collared coats and tall top hats. The woman has wide eyes and a small mouth, wearing a bonnet and cloak, with hair peeking out in curls. All individuals have exaggerated, expressive features. The background is filled with market goods like vases and lanterns, indicating a marketplace setting. The scene is captured in black and white, highlighting the lively setting of the street fair.

artworks.title: Fureur de Mr Cobden ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two stylized figures in a confrontational scene. It shows two caricature-like figures engaged in a dynamic interaction. One figure is kicking the other, who is holding a newspaper with an expression of surprise. The backdrop suggests an indoor setting, indicated by the presence of a table with a book on it, and frames on the wall. The figures are executed in a highly exaggerated manner, emphasizing their facial expressions and physical gestures. The drawing uses strong lines and cross-hatching to create shading and texture.

artworks.title: Mmrs. Cobden, Gladsone et Brigth ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals. A woman on the left is holding an olive branch toward three men on the right. The woman has her hair tied up and is wearing a draped garment. The men are formally dressed, with one in a checkered suit and hat, holding a spear-like object. The other two men wear dark suits and hats. The background features lined text, and a simple line to indicate the ground.

artworks.title: He bien! t'ant pis!...nous plaiderons. j'aime mieux ça...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals in formal attire engaged in conversation. The image shows three figures, each wearing top hats, with exaggerated features emphasizing their facial expressions. They appear to be engaged in an animated discussion, reflected in their hand gestures and facial expressions. The figures are set against a plain background. The drawing captures human interaction with a humorous and exaggerated touch, typical of satirical and caricature art.

artworks.title: Ayant trop fêté la Saint-Hubert
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image is a caricature showing two individuals in motion. The person on the left has exaggerated facial features, wearing a hat and a long coat. The person on the right also has exaggerated features, with curly hair and a loose garment. They appear to be holding hands. The background features a simple landscape with trees and a building.

artworks.title: Willows, Longpre, France
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Armistead Peter III [Caroline Ogden-Jones Peter], 1962)
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene with a high horizon line. Trees can be seen across the river, with lush greenery framing the water's edge. The painting features impressionistic brushstrokes, with short, swirling motions for foliage and water, creating a dynamic texture. The color palette consists of earthy greens, blues, yellows, and ochres, conveying a vibrant and natural landscape.

artworks.title: Ship in a Squall
artworks.artist: Seth Wells Cheney and John Cheney after Washington Allston
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts a seascape with a low horizon line, showing a stormy ocean under dark skies. A sailing ship is visible on the horizon, with expressive lines marking swirling waves and clouds. The color palette is primarily sepia, emphasizing contrasts between light and shadow. Waves crash in the foreground, mirroring the cloud patterns in the sky.

artworks.title: Musidora
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a natural outdoor setting. She is leaning slightly to her left with one hand resting on a rock, while her other hand holds a cloth across her torso and hips. The woman has long, wavy hair and a serene expression on her face. She is barefoot amidst foliage, with a river to her left and trees in the background.

artworks.title: Study for "The Defeat of the Floating Batteries at Gibraltar"
artworks.medium: graphite with white chalk on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing featuring four individuals in dynamic poses. The figures are depicted from head to toe, each in energetic positions, appearing to propel themselves forward. Starting from the left, the first person leans in a bent stance, stretching one arm forward; he has short hair and is dressed in a suit with shoes. The second person extends both arms outward, their forward thrust highlighted by forward-leaning posture, wearing similarly styled clothing and also having short hair. The third person is more obscured, appearing between the other two figures, with their head turned slightly in profile, showing long hair. The fourth figure is crouched with one arm extended downwards and the other upwards. All individuals are dressed in suits with long trousers and are positioned on what appears to be a triangular surface. The background of the drawing is devoid of detail, focusing attention on the movement and posture of the figures, drawn on a blue-tinted textured paper with grid lines faintly visible across the entire image.

artworks.title: Girl in Bow of Canoe Spreading Out Her Loin-Cloth for a Sail, Samoa
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1960)
artworks.description: This painting depicts a woman standing at the edge of a small wooden boat, facing the right and holding up a blue cloth that billows in the breeze. The woman has pale skin and short brown hair, and she is nude. The boat is on calm water with gentle ripples. The water and the sky above it are in shades of pale blue and pale green, with some hints of pink and yellow.

artworks.title: Hillside with Houses and Figures
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1962)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a landscape from an elevated point. Buildings are on the right, with people on a curved path. Trees, hills, and a descending hillside are visible. The sketch uses light pencil strokes to depict soft textures and shading. It has a grayscale palette and varying textures. Stonework and vegetation are detailed, blending into a gently sketched horizon. Farther back, trees and hills are outlined with soft strokes, conveying a calm landscape.

artworks.title: Head of a Man Wearing a Cap
artworks.artist: Circle of the Master of Santo Spirito
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person's face and part of their shoulders. The individual is in a slightly downward-facing pose, with their head tilted to one side. They have finely drawn facial features including eyes, a nose, and closed lips with a solemn expression. The person's hair is long and wavy, flowing past their ears. They are wearing a soft, textured cap that covers most of the top of their head and extends towards the back. The background is a plain, textured surface that complements the sepia tones of the portrait. No jewelry or objects are visible on the person.
